scripts.build: npm run build -w astro-book && npm run build -w @astro-book/basic
scripts.check: astro check --root packages/astro-book --tsconfig tsconfig.check.json && npm run check -w @astro-book/basic
scripts.dev: npm run build -w astro-book && npm run dev -w @astro-book/basic
scripts.release:check: npm run build && npm run check && npm test && npm run verify:package
